skill.displayName: Happy Woman Bikini AI Pic – API-powered
skill.summary: Happy woman bikini AI pic — transform a person photo into a bikini model image or video

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "happy-woman-bikini-ai-pic" skill (v1.0.0).
- Transforms a person photo into a bikini model image or video using WeShop OpenAPI.
- Requires HTTPS access to openapi.weshop.ai and a WESHOP_API_KEY.
- Supports specifying input images, optional text description, output type (video/image), and batch count.
- Includes secure handling instructions for API keys.
